name: BulletFormat2
example:
With ActivePresentation.Slides(1).Shapes(2)
 With .TextFrame.TextRange.ParagraphFormat.BulletFormat2
 .Visible = True
 .RelativeSize = 1.25
 .Character = 169
 With .Font
 .Color.RGB = RGB(255, 255, 0)
 .Name = "Symbol"
 End With
 End With
End With

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Gets an object that represents the BulletFormat2 object. Read-only.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Gets a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which the BulletFormat2 object was created. Read-only.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Gets the parent of the BulletFormat2 object. Read-only.

properties.name: Character
properties.description: Gets or sets the Unicode character value that is used for bullets in the specified text. Read/write.

properties.name: Font
properties.description: Gets a Font2 object that represents character formatting for a BulletFormat2 object. Read-only.

properties.name: Number
properties.description: Gets the bullet number of a paragraph. Read-only.

properties.name: RelativeSize
properties.description: Returns or sets the bullet size relative to the size of the first text character in the paragraph. Read/write.

properties.name: StartValue
properties.description: Gets or sets the beginning value of a bulleted list. Read/write.

properties.name: Style
properties.description: Returns or sets a constant that represents the style of a bullet. Read/write.

properties.name: Type
properties.description: Gets or sets a constant that represents the type of bullet. Read/write.

properties.name: UseTextColor
properties.description: Determines whether the specified bullets are set to the color of the first text character in the paragraph. Read/write.

properties.name: UseTextFont
properties.description: Determines whether the specified bullets are set to the font of the first text character in the paragraph. Read/write.

properties.name: Visible
properties.description: Gets or sets a value that specifies whether the bullet is visible. Read/write.

methods.name: Picture
methods.description: Sets the graphics file to be used for bullets in a bulleted list.

parameters.name: FileName
parameters.description: The file name of a valid graphics file.
